thread:
Ada: Quick sync — I'm doing a docs PR sweep to align naming before the SDK v1.2 cut. Goal: make public docs consistent, update SDK snippets, and add a short migration note for customers. I'll batch changes where it makes sense and split into reviewable commits.
Matt: +1 on cleanup. batching is fine but prefer commits scoped to a section so reviews are fast. Can we have a checklist in the PR description? :thumbsup:
Ada: Yes — plan in PR: 1) a single glossary mapping file with canonical terms, 2) update examples and SDK snippets, 3) migration guide section, 4) add a lint rule to catch deprecated terms. I'll open the PR now and attach the checklist.
Lina: For the lint rule I can add a remark-lint rule (docs repo already uses remark). Suggest we also add a CI job that runs the grep check on changed files.
Sukhi: Heads up — some examples in redwood-sdk/examples still use `dedicated_capacity` and `model_family`. Those break the new SDK parameter names. We should include a short automated script to patch examples and surface any runtime param mismatches.
Ada: Good catch. I'll include a migration snippet in the PR. Also adding a note for Dedicated vs dedicated (capitalization) — recommend we consistently use Capitalized product names in marketing pages and lowercase in code.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — labels: docs, pr-sweep, needs-review
James: I'll review SDK snippet changes. Can you add the exact commands you used to update examples so reviewers can reproduce? :eyes:
Ada: Pasted the small helper below for reviewers to run locally if needed.
Ada: ```bash
# find files with deprecated phrases and replace with canonical terms
git grep -n "model_family\|dedicated_capacity" -- '*.md' 'sdk/**' | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | xargs -I{} sed -i "s/model_family/model line/g; s/dedicated_capacity/dedicatedCapacity/g" {}
# quick grep to confirm
git grep -n "model_family\|dedicated_capacity" || echo "no matches"
```
Matt: Nice — include that in the PR body under "How to validate". Keeps reviews frictionless.
Lina: I'll add the remark-lint plugin as a separate commit on top (so CI can fail-fast). Also propose these canonical mappings in the glossary file:
- "model family" -> "model line"
- "model variant" remains as-is
- "best-effort endpoint" -> "fallback route"
- "Dedicated" (product) -> Capitalized in product docs, `dedicated` in config examples
Sukhi: For the migration guide: add a short code diff showing old->new SDK params and a note on compatibility (v1.1 clients still accepted until 2026-06-30). We should also send a short customer email after the docs land.
Ada: Sounds good. I'll tag product + support in the PR for the compatibility blurb.
James: Quick note — update the Quickstarts index page link to the new snippets path, I found one 404 under /docs/quickstarts/python. I'll patch in my review.
Ada: Thanks — aim to merge Fri EOD unless a blocker is found. If anyone wants a separate smaller PR instead of this sweep, tell me and I'll split it out. :wave:
Matt: No blockers from infra/docs side. :thumbsup:
Lina: I'll queue the lint change now and post the package PR link when ready. :eyes:
Sukhi: I'll follow up with a tiny examples patch for the SDK repo after the docs PR merges.
Ada: Great — closing the loop here. PR link again: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (checklist + how-to-validate included).
